原文: -The Plan -
含占位符: -The Plan -

原文: The plan of the invasión is based on the modified plan of Heer, considering the Channel like a big river.
含占位符: The plan of the invasión is based on the modified plan of Heer, considering the Channel like a big river.

原文: The crossing of the first wave of troops would be made by 13 divisions in four days, with around 250.000 mens and 650 tanks, transported on barges and many different ships. The first objetives would be the ports of South England, like Dover and Portsmouth. Later, the next waves of disembarks will consist of 3 motorized divisions, 6 Panzer divisions and 17 infantry divisions. The supply areas are between Dover and Margate, with the Kriegsmarine custodying the zone.
